name: Store Notifier – Notifications System for WooCommerce
author: wpmobo

sections.description:
Notifications plugin for WooCommerce order, Cart Abandoned and more

StoreNotifier helping store owners streamline order management and stay informed with real-time notifications and insights. It features a variety of alert systems and statistics that enable admins to handle orders efficiently without constantly checking the dashboard.

Simplifies WooCommerce order management, saving time and boosting efficiency with real-time notifications and insightful analytics tailored for WooCommerce store admins.

Notifications for WooCommerce is a powerful feature that keeps store owners informed about important order updates in real-time. It helps streamline order management by sending instant alerts for events like new orders, order completions, cancellations, and more. These notifications can be delivered via the WordPress dashboard, email, or integrated platforms like whatsapp, ensuring admins stay updated and never miss critical order activities. Perfect for improving efficiency and enhancing customer satisfaction in WooCommerce-powered stores.

👁️ Demo | Documentation

Cart Abandoned

Cart Abandoned Toast Notification is a feature designed to help online store owners recover potential lost sales by reminding customers about the items left in their carts. When a customer adds products to their cart but does not complete the checkout process, this notification serves as a gentle reminder of the abandoned cart. This feature helps reduce cart abandonment rates, enhances customer engagement, and boosts overall store revenue.

Whatsapp Notification

whatsapp Notification is a key feature of the StoreNotifier plugin that allows store admins to stay updated on important order activities via whatsapp. This feature sends real-time notifications for the following events:

  • Admin New Order Notification: Instantly notifies the admin whenever a new order is placed.
  • Admin Order Completed Notification: Alerts the admin when an order is successfully completed.
  • Admin Order Cancelled Notification: Notifies the admin if an order is cancelled.

With whatsapp Notification, store owners can manage their orders efficiently, ensuring they are always informed and able to respond promptly, even when not logged into the WordPress dashboard.

Free Version Features

  1. Whatsapp Notification – Real-time order updates sent directly via whatsapp, keeping store admins informed wherever they are.
  2. Real-Time New Order whatsapp Alerts – Admin receives instant whatsapp notifications specifically for new orders, enabling immediate action.
  3. Real-Time Order Status Cancelled whatsapp Notification – Admin informed if an order is cancelled, allowing for quick follow-up.
  4. Real-Time Order Status Completed whatsapp Notification – Admin Get notified instantly when an order is marked as completed.
  5. Real-Time New Order Toast Notifications in Admin – Instantly receive pop-up alerts for every new order, directly in the admin panel.
  6. Cart Abandoned Toast Notification – Get timely notifications when carts are abandoned, helping you re-engage potential customers and recover sales.
  7. Order Statistics in Admin Order Table – View current date order stats within the order table for quick insights into daily performance.
  8. User-Friendly & Customizable – StoreNotifier offers an intuitive design and easy customization options to suit your specific needs.
  9. Translation ready – Built to support multiple languages, making it ideal for a global user base.
  10. Compatible with Free & Premium Themes – Seamlessly integrates with both free and premium WordPress themes, ensuring flexibility and ease of use.
  11. Unlimited update

How to use:-
Very easy to use, after active the StoreNotifier plugin just go to Dashboard -> StoreNotifier. You will find all settings to use.

3rd Party Service Used

We used twilio API for WhatsApp chat integration to send notifications. Relevant link below.

https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01/Accounts/$TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID/Messages.json

Privacy Policy

StoreNotifier uses Appsero SDK to collect some telemetry data upon user’s confirmation. This helps us to troubleshoot problems faster & make product improvements.

Appsero SDK does not gather any data by default. The SDK only starts gathering basic telemetry data when a user allows it via the admin notice. We collect the data to ensure a great user experience for all our users.

Integrating Appsero SDK DOES NOT IMMEDIATELY start gathering data, without confirmation from users in any case.

Learn more about how Appsero collects and uses this data.
sections.installation:
The easy way.

Go to your WordPress Dashboard. Navigate to Plugins > Add New and then search for “StoreNotifier”. Click on Install and then Activate the Plugin.

That’s it, StoreNotifier Plugin is now activated on your site!

The hard way..

Download “StoreNotifier WordPress Plugin” and then extract the zip file and just drop the contents in the wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress installation and then activate the Plugin from Plugins page.

Is this plugin compatable on latest wordpress ?

Yes
